purpose: Stable machine-readable interface for AI agents using Automate as a local mathematical and physics verification working environment.

compatibility.principle: Agents provide structured untrusted mathematical claims; Automate performs representation, rule validation, backend verification, provenance binding, and certificate generation.

discovery.runtime_state: capabilities --json reports optional backend/provider availability; this contract describes the interface and supported feature families.

command_protocol.input_convention: CLI arguments plus UTF-8 JSON files where a command accepts structured artifacts.
command_protocol.output_convention: Use --json for machine-readable output. Human-oriented commands without --json are not part of the stable machine protocol.
command_protocol.failure_convention: Verification failures are returned as structured status/evidence where supported; unsupported semantics must not be upgraded to verified.
command_protocol.side_effect_rule: Commands marked read_only do not modify the supplied derivation graph. Commands marked write_output create or update explicitly requested output artifacts.

discover.purpose: Discover active backends, AI providers, rule IDs, and this contract.

parse.purpose: Parse declarative YAML/JSON theory into canonical derivation-graph IR.

context.purpose: Expose sanitized mathematical state, assumptions, obligations, and available rules to an agent.

validate.purpose: Validate an untrusted proposal against schema, security rules, graph dependencies, and approved transformation rules.

propose_dry_run.purpose: Inject an AI proposal into a cloned graph, synthesize obligations, and run applicable verification without changing the canonical graph.

propose_apply.purpose: Apply and verify a validated proposal, attach evidence/certificate state, and persist the updated graph to the requested output path.

research.purpose: Run a bounded proposal/validation/verification research loop.

check.purpose: Run symbolic and dimensional checks applicable to graph edges.

prove.purpose: Run Lean 4 formal proof checks on edges configured for the Lean backend.

simulate.purpose: Run bounded SciPy RK45 ODE integration and numerical evidence checks.

stats.purpose: Run empirical parameter estimation, uncertainty diagnostics, and chi-square goodness-of-fit checks where configured.

query_assumptions.purpose: Inspect assumption dependencies or simulate removal of a specific assumption.
query_assumptions.returns: assumption dependency or invalidation impact report

expand.purpose: Losslessly expand a composite derivation edge into certificate micro-steps.

visualize.purpose: Generate a standalone interactive HTML derivation graph visualization.

report.purpose: Return the canonical graph and verification state matrix as JSON.

export_certificate.purpose: Export the machine-auditable certificate package and cryptographic manifest.

schema.purpose: Retrieve authoritative interchange schemas and this machine-agent capability contract.

demo.purpose: Run the canonical end-to-end harmonic oscillator demonstration.

capability_inventory.purpose: Inspect capability ownership, reconciliation, dependencies and verification state without conflating roadmap state with implementation state.

learning.purpose: Record experience, learn conservative strategies, triage discoveries, and manage bounded self-evolution artifacts without granting certification authority.

self_evolution.purpose: Create one exact-SHA atomic maintenance commit and ordinary PR from an adopted mutable evolution plan. Never self-merges or certifies.

mathematics: division with explicit nonzero proof requirements
scalar differentiation of arbitrary positive integer order
scalar limits with explicit two-sided and one-sided direction semantics
limits toward positive and negative infinity
pointwise continuity derived from explicit limit equality with the function value
ordinary differential equation solution verification by residual substitution
scalar and vector field representation in Cartesian coordinates
Stokes' theorem on planar Cartesian rectangles
